shortBio.en: Oasis's sneering microphone—and Noel's necessary opposite.
shortBio.zh: Oasis 的挑衅麦克风——以及 Noel 的必要对体。

whyHub.en: Frontman as attitude engine; the feud is part of the historical object, not gossip only.
whyHub.zh: 主唱作为态度引擎；反目是历史对象的一部分，不只是八卦。

body.en: Liam's hub page exists so Tropes like sibling feud can point to people, not vague vibes. Solo years after Oasis keep the voice moving while the classic lineup stays frozen as a version.
body.zh: Liam 枢纽页存在，是为了让「兄弟必反目」一类梗能指向具体的人，而不是模糊气氛。Oasis 之后的独奏让嗓音继续走，经典阵容则冻结为一个版本。
